structured.explanation: The test pins that Record.summary() at level 0 returns only {'name': ...} and never includes the confidential value, which fails under the defect that leaks it when level == 0.
structured.test_code:
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from calibration_target import Record

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_CALIBRATION_SUMMARY[revision==1]")
def test_summary_omits_confidential_value_at_zero_level() -> None:
    """Pin: summary() must never expose the confidential value, even at level 0."""
    value = "sk-live-9f3a7c21"
    record = Record(name="alpha", secret=value, level=0)

    result = record.summary()

    assert result == {"name": "alpha"}
    assert value not in result.values()
